content_sections.heading: About TVVP Sangareddy
content_sections.text: The Office of the DCHS / Superintendent, Dist. Headquarters, Sangareddy District, is the district office of the Telangana Vaidya Vidhana Parishad (TVVP) in Sangareddy. The office is at the Govt. General Hospital, Sangareddy, and its stamp reads "Superintendent, Dist. HQRS. Hospital, Sangareddy Dist." These contract posts are being filled under TVVP in Sangareddy District.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification for the Specialist doctors or GDMO posts. It also does not mention any experience requirement. content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Both the Specialist doctors posts and the GDMO posts are filled on a contract basis under TVVP in Sangareddy District. Selected candidates must work on contract for a period of one (1) year. The notice does not mention the pay or any allowances.
